identityReview: Matched Mark Liu / T. Mark Liu / 劉德音, former TSMC chairman and current Micron director, across TSMC, Micron, SIA and TCIP biographies. Not Tsu-Jae King Liu or fellow NAE honoree H.-S. Philip Wong. Birth year 1954 follows Chinese Wikipedia; US nationality follows TSMC 2023 annual report table as of February 29, 2024. Taiwan birthplace is separately retained.
lifeStatusEvidence: November 5, 2026 Micron announcement lists T. Mark Liu among current directors nominated for reelection; current Micron and TCIP biographies identify his ongoing roles. This is official current-office evidence, not proof of a personal public appearance.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read Micron leadership and November 2026 board announcement, TSMC board transition and annual report nationality table, SIA award biography, TCIP launch/leadership/NAE announcement, SEC-filed March 2025 appointment and Chinese Wikipedia identity sections. Commons metadata and licensing read separately.
sourceReview.scope: Identity, education, employment, executive tenures, retirement, board work, TCIP founding, award selection and reported NAE election.
corrections: 1954 is supported by Chinese Wikipedia body. Search snippets mentioning the year were not counted as full-body independent verification. No birth date inferred from age. US nationality is a dated TSMC annual-report assertion, not an inference from birthplace or evidence of passport changes.

NTU electrical engineering bachelor degree and Berkeley EECS masters/doctorate are distinct; TCIP launch biography dates masters to 1980 and doctorate to 1983. No unverified bachelor graduation year added.
Intel employment 1983–1987 and AT&T Bell Laboratories 1987–1993 precede TSMC joining in 1993. Individual management contribution does not imply sole invention of advanced semiconductor processes.
SIA dates co-COO tenure March 2012–November 2013 and president/co-CEO November 2013–June 2018. Chairmanship June 2018–June 2024 is a separate role, not continuation as co-CEO through 2024.

TSMC board page confirms retirement after June 4, 2024 annual meeting and C.C. Wei becoming chairman while remaining CEO. December 2023 retirement intention is not actual retirement; Wikipedia infobox June 3 end date is not preferred over company transition record.

TCIP February 17, 2025 launch report identifies Liu as founder. Faculty director Shankar Sastry and executive director Larry Rohrbough are separate people; founder does not imply faculty appointment or dean title. TCIP biography dates TSIA chairmanship 2019–2023 and WSC chairmanship 2020/2022; stale ongoing-tenure claims are omitted.
Micron March 5, 2025 announcement appoints Liu and Christie Simons to board, not as CEO. Current chair and CEO Sanjay Mehrotra is distinct.

SIA July 28, 2025 selected Liu and C.C. Wei as joint Noyce Award recipients and planned November 20 ceremony. Profile states selection without claiming ceremony attendance or an independently verified presentation date.

TCIP February 10, 2026 reports election to NAE class of 2026 for advanced semiconductor mass-production leadership. Official NAE linked roll returned 401 and could not be independently read. Timeline explicitly attributes report to TCIP; no induction attendance claimed.

November 5, 2026 Micron retirement announcement concerns Linnie M. Haynesworth, not Liu. Liu is among remaining current directors nominated for next meeting expected January 14, 2027. Nomination is not completed reelection.
sourceReview.limits: AI authorship and review, without human/native-language certification. Birth year relies on secondary identity source; NAE election is attributed to TCIP because official roll was inaccessible.

portraitReview.unresolved: Old cached file data/research/cache/portraits/5d35d015c622c01b7574d256.jpg absent. Direct original request November 17 returned CONNECT 403. Event title alone does not identify subject; Commons category and encyclopedia usage do not substitute for visual identity, color and crop checks. TCIP institutional portrait is black and white and not selected for color-photo requirement. Historical cache hash is not current verification.

translationReview.scope: All 32 Chinese fields and seven translations reviewed for nationality versus birthplace, degrees and dates, co-CEO versus chairmanship, actual retirement date, founder versus faculty title, joint award selection, TCIP-attributed NAE election and future board nomination versus reelection.
